errors.evidence: The chart contains seven distinct data series (lines), not six.

errors.evidence: The 'Renewable energy' line, like all other lines, starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, as this is the base year for the index.
The 'Renewable energy' line ends at a value of approximately 148 in 2018, not 140.
The line for 'Other' is cyan/turquoise, not light green ('светлозелена'). The light green/chartreuse line represents 'Crude oil'.
The 'Other' line starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, not 110.
The 'Other' line ends at a value of approximately 145 in 2018, not 125.
The 'Total production' line never goes above the index value of 100. The description appears to confuse this line with the 'Other' line, which peaks around 133 in 2013.
The 'Total production' line ends at an index value of approximately 91 in 2018, not 104.
The 'Nuclear energy' line ends at a value of approximately 85 in 2018, not 80.
The 'Solid fossil fuels' line starts at the index value of 100 in 2008, not 90.
The line for 'Crude oil' is green/chartreuse, not yellow ('жълта').
The 'Crude oil' line ends at a value of approximately 65 in 2018, not 60.
The line for 'Natural gas' is a medium blue color. The 'Total production' line is dark blue ('тъмносиня').
The 'Natural gas' line ends at a value of approximately 53 in 2018, not 75.
The description fails to mention that the 'Total production' line is thicker than the other lines, a visual feature used for emphasis.
